# GOV.UK
> The UK government’s central website for public services, guidance, policy, departments, news, and official information.

GOV.UK brings together service transactions, step-by-step guidance, policy publications, departmental information, and government announcements for people, businesses, and professionals in the UK.

## Core Navigation
- [Home](https://www.gov.uk/): Main entry point for UK government services and information.
- [Services and information](https://www.gov.uk/browse): Browse all major public service categories and topics.
- [Departments](https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations): Find government departments, agencies, and public bodies.
- [Government activity](https://www.gov.uk/government): Access policy, publications, consultations, and announcements.
- [News and communications](https://www.gov.uk/search/news-and-communications): Search government news, speeches, and official communications.
- [Search GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/search/all): Search across services, guidance, news, and publications.

## Services and Information
- [Benefits](https://www.gov.uk/browse/benefits): Benefits, financial support, pensions, and welfare information.
- [Births, deaths, marriages and care](https://www.gov.uk/browse/births-deaths-marriages): Register life events, arrange care, and manage related services.
- [Business and self-employed](https://www.gov.uk/browse/business): Start, run, and grow a business or work self-employed.
- [Childcare and parenting](https://www.gov.uk/browse/childcare-parenting): Childcare support, schools, parenting, and family-related services.
- [Citizenship and living in the UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/citizenship): Citizenship, voting, legal status, and living in the UK.
- [Crime, justice and the law](https://www.gov.uk/browse/justice): Courts, policing, legal rights, and justice services.
- [Disabled people](https://www.gov.uk/browse/disabilities): Disability benefits, rights, carers, and accessibility support.
- [Driving and transport](https://www.gov.uk/browse/driving): Driving licences, vehicle tax, transport rules, and road safety.

## More Service Categories
- [Education and learning](https://www.gov.uk/browse/education): Schools, qualifications, student finance, and lifelong learning.
- [Employing people](https://www.gov.uk/browse/employing-people): Recruitment, payroll, workplace rights, and employer responsibilities.
- [Environment and countryside](https://www.gov.uk/browse/environment-countryside): Farming, waste, flooding, wildlife, and environmental regulation.
- [Housing and local services](https://www.gov.uk/browse/housing-local-services): Housing, council services, planning, and local government information.
- [Money and tax](https://www.gov.uk/browse/tax): Income tax, VAT, self assessment, and financial responsibilities.
- [Passports, travel and living abroad](https://www.gov.uk/browse/abroad): Passports, foreign travel advice, and overseas living guidance.
- [Visas and immigration](https://www.gov.uk/browse/visas-immigration): Visas, settlement, asylum, and immigration rules.
- [Working, jobs and pensions](https://www.gov.uk/browse/working): Employment rights, job search, pensions, and retirement information.

## Government
- [Government activity](https://www.gov.uk/government): Overview of policy, ministers, departments, and current government work.
- [Organisations](https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations): Directory of departments, agencies, and public bodies.
- [Ministers](https://www.gov.uk/government/ministers): Profiles and responsibilities of government ministers.
- [Policy papers and consultations](https://www.gov.uk/search/policy-papers-and-consultations): Search policy documents, white papers, and consultations.
- [Guidance and regulation](https://www.gov.uk/search/guidance-and-regulation): Search official guidance, statutory guidance, and regulations.
- [Research and statistics](https://www.gov.uk/search/research-and-statistics): Search government research publications and official statistics.
- [Transparency and freedom of information releases](https://www.gov.uk/search/transparency-and-freedom-of-information-releases): Search transparency data and FOI releases.
- [Worldwide](https://www.gov.uk/world): UK government activity and services around the world.

## News and Communications
- [News and communications search](https://www.gov.uk/search/news-and-communications): Search all government news, statements, and announcements.
- [Announcements](https://www.gov.uk/search/news-and-communications?content_store_document_type=announcement): Official announcements from government departments and bodies.
- [News stories](https://www.gov.uk/search/news-and-communications?content_store_document_type=news_story): Departmental and cross-government news stories.
- [Press releases](https://www.gov.uk/search/news-and-communications?content_store_document_type=press_release): Official press releases issued by government organisations.
- [Speeches](https://www.gov.uk/search/news-and-communications?content_store_document_type=speech): Ministerial and departmental speeches and statements.
- [Statements to Parliament](https://www.gov.uk/search/news-and-communications?content_store_document_type=statement_to_parliament): Written and oral statements presented to Parliament.
- [World news stories](https://www.gov.uk/search/news-and-communications?content_store_document_type=world_news_story): International news from UK government missions abroad.

## Publications and Reference
- [Publications search](https://www.gov.uk/search/all?keywords=&order=relevance): Search publications, guidance, services, and official content.
- [Guidance and regulation search](https://www.gov.uk/search/guidance-and-regulation): Find practical guidance and regulatory information.
- [Policy papers and consultations search](https://www.gov.uk/search/policy-papers-and-consultations): Find policy proposals, consultations, and formal papers.
- [Research and statistics search](https://www.gov.uk/search/research-and-statistics): Find datasets, reports, and official statistics.
- [Transparency search](https://www.gov.uk/search/transparency-and-freedom-of-information-releases): Find transparency publications and FOI material.
- [Official Statistics](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics): Browse official statistics published by government.
- [Publications](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications): Browse government publications across departments and topics.

## Popular Services
- [Universal Credit](https://www.gov.uk/universal-credit): Apply for and manage Universal Credit benefits.
- [State Pension](https://www.gov.uk/state-pension): Check eligibility, claim, and understand State Pension rules.
- [Check your State Pension forecast](https://www.gov.uk/check-state-pension): View your State Pension forecast online.
- [Personal tax account](https://www.gov.uk/personal-tax-account): Manage tax records, PAYE, and HMRC services online.
- [Self Assessment tax returns](https://www.gov.uk/self-assessment-tax-returns): File tax returns and manage Self Assessment obligations.
- [Apply for a passport](https://www.gov.uk/apply-renew-passport): Apply for or renew a UK passport.
- [Register to vote](https://www.gov.uk/register-to-vote): Register to vote in UK elections.
- [Check MOT history](https://www.gov.uk/check-mot-history): View MOT test history for a vehicle.

## Business and Tax Services
- [HMRC services](https://www.gov.uk/topic/dealing-with-hmrc): Access HMRC guidance, tools, and tax-related services.
- [VAT](https://www.gov.uk/vat-rates): Find VAT rates and related tax guidance.
- [Corporation Tax](https://www.gov.uk/corporation-tax): Understand Corporation Tax responsibilities for companies.
- [PAYE for employers](https://www.gov.uk/paye-for-employers): Run payroll and report employee pay and deductions.
- [Set up as a sole trader](https://www.gov.uk/set-up-sole-trader): Register and operate as a sole trader.
- [Register a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/limited-company-formation): Form a private limited company in the UK.
- [Business support helpline](https://www.gov.uk/business-support-helpline): Find government business support contact information.
- [Employing staff](https://www.gov.uk/employing-staff): Learn the main legal steps for hiring employees.

## Travel, Identity and Immigration
- [Foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice): Country-specific travel safety and entry guidance.
- [Visas and immigration](https://www.gov.uk/browse/visas-immigration): Browse visa, settlement, and immigration topics.
- [Check if you need a UK visa](https://www.gov.uk/check-uk-visa): Determine visa requirements for travel to the UK.
- [Apply to visit the UK](https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor): Visitor visa rules and application guidance.
- [View and prove your immigration status](https://www.gov.uk/view-prove-immigration-status): Access digital immigration status services.
- [Renew or replace your adult passport](https://www.gov.uk/renew-adult-passport): Renew or replace an adult UK passport.
- [Driving licences](https://www.gov.uk/browse/driving/driving-licences): Apply for, renew, or update a driving licence.
- [Vehicle tax](https://www.gov.uk/vehicle-tax): Tax a vehicle and understand vehicle tax rules.
